title: [3.0 Beta 10/11] Crashes after start
body:
Beta 10 at Pixel 5 (Android 12) 
Unable to initialize after fresh Installation or Update.
No logs available.
No configuration. It crashes directly after start.

Everything is working fine now, with Beta 11.

I had the same.
I deinstalled and have done a new installation.
Then I started many times and it crashes after one second
Then I was fast enough to click to the BT permissions.
After that, it was working well, still without the new Install Wizard.

Then I got to the details of the app in Android and cleared all data. After that it was starting with the new Installation wizard.

Right now, its working well.
Yes I also managed to click the dismiss button after multiple tries, after that it started working (crashed once more though I think).

I am also have the same issue with Dana I Beta 11.

I finally got it to work by clearing the Bluetooth storage, and then starting and immediately clicking on Request Bluetooth permission.

Not a great long term solution.

Thanks

> clearing the Bluetooth storage

How did you clear bluetooth storage? Do you mean the app storage?

Yes app, selected system apps located bluetooth storage then clear.

But it has not solved the issue.  Happened again today.  So I exited the AAPS. reopened and it connected.

Could this issue bei closed?
After clearing all caches and data, and with a new clean installation all is working well. So I think it's no longer an bug.
Upgrades are still a problem though, so the permission could be requested in a better way, maybe?

> Could this issue bei closed? After clearing all caches and data, and with a new clean installation all is working well. So I think it's no longer an bug.

This is not a real solution because people don't want to lose all settings every time they upgrade. This is still a bug.
